title: Quantitative Local Structure Analysis of Crystal Interfaces Using 4D-STEM
content: The convergent-beam electron diffraction (CBED) offers nanometer-scale local structure analysis through quantitative comparison between experimental CBED patterns and simulated ones based on the dynamical diffraction theory (quantitative CBED: QCBED). Successful QCBED applications include determining atom positions and atomic displacement parameters [1,2], low-order structure factors [3,4], and Hubbard parameters [5].
